_doc: Explicit, reviewed exceptions for joining SDM ccode (COW-style) to QoG ccodecow. Default rule: equal codes AND the per-code name check in outputs/country_crosswalk_audit.csv. Anything not covered stays unmatched (GDP stratum 'unknown'); nothing is imputed.

overrides.reason: QoG codes unified Germany 255 from 1991; West Germany (COW 260) has no QoG row before 1991, so 1949-1990 stays unmatched.

known_unmatched.reason: No QoG row for the Republic of Vietnam.
